Aaron (Support): Escalating: trial account 'Clearbay' hitting 403 on embed ingest after SSO. Renewal in 8 days, marked P0. :rotating_light:
Lena (CS): Acknowledged. Paste repro and any error output please, and share the account owner's contact. I'll draft an urgent comms plan.
Aaron (Support): Repro:
```
GET /auth/callback 302 -> /app/home
POST /api/embed/ingest 403 {"status":403, "msg":"tenant_not_mapped"}
```
Aaron (Support): Account: clearbay-trial, region=us-west-1, SSO=Okta. Cleared local cache and rotated keys, no change.
Marco (Eng): I'm looking at recent mapping changes. There's a tenant-mapper deploy ~1hr ago. Pulling logs now. :mag_right:
Tara (Solutions): Suggested comms: 1) immediate ack + 30m ETA; 2) provide manual-mapping workaround; 3) offer 1:1 enablement and a short post-session feedback survey to help with renewal. I'll draft copy and KB link.
Lena (CS): Good. Aaron  who is the customer owner and timezone? I'll set a hold calendar and update CRM.
Aaron (Support): Owner is @jess.clearbay, PST. Sent a quick note and scheduled a 10:30 PST sync.
Marco (Eng): Confirmed regression in tenant-mapper when tenant IDs contain 'trial' suffix. Hotfix branch ready, running test suite (~18m).
notify-bot: deploy-start tenant-mapper-hotfix 1824681500
Marco (Eng): Tests passed, promoting to prod now.
notify-bot: deploy-succeeded tenant-mapper-hotfix 1824681615
Marco (Eng): Post-deploy verification: auth -> embed flow succeeds for clearbay-trial in smoke tests. 403 resolved.
Lena (CS): I'll confirm with @jess.clearbay and propose a 30-minute enablement session to walk through the flow and capture feedback. Temporarily clearing the "renewal-at-risk" tag until after the session.
Aaron (Support): Closing the support ticket and marking as escalated->CS for follow-ups (enablement invite, post-call summary, renewal check).
Tara (Solutions): I'll send the enablement invite with timeline, workaround steps, and a 3-question feedback form link. KB ref: https://redwood.internal/kb/tenant-mapping/manual.
Lena (CS): Action items assigned: 1) Enablement owner: Tara; 2) Customer-facing summary + technical note: Marco; 3) Renewal follow-up in 7 days: Lena. Updating CRM and adding notes. :white_check_mark:
